utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon. This is case number IT-01-47-PT, the Prosecutor versus Enver Hadzihasanovic, Mehmed Alagic, and Amir Kubura.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes. May I have the parties, please. The Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. WITHOPF
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Good afternoon, counsel. For the Prosecution appear Mr. David Re, trial attorney, Ms. Kimberly Fleming, trial support, and I, Ekkehard Withopf, acting senior trial attorney.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Thank you. The Defence. Yes, the Defence.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. My name is Edina Residovic, for Mr. Enver Hadzihasanovic; I also want to apologise for my colleague, Stefane Bourgon, because of some previous appointments for the Defence, he's unable to attend. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MS. VIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honours. My name is Vasvija Vidovic. Together with Mr. John Jones, I represented General Mehmed Alagic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. IBRISIMOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honours. My name is Fahrudin Ibrisimovic, counsel, together with Mr. Dixon, we represent the defence of Mr. Kubura.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Thank you. I understand the Defence of the late Mr. Mehmed Alagic has information to -- for the Trial Chamber.

utterances.speaker: MS. VIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I have a very sad duty today, to inform you officially that General Mehmed Alagic, due to a heart attack, he died on Friday, the 7th of March, 2003, in Sanski Most. I have prepared a death certificate, and I will hand it over to you. And I have already handed it over to the Prosecutor, at a meeting we had earlier, I provided a copy of this certificate. All other information, I have agreed that it would be through the state organs that this would be forwarded to the Trial Chamber, so this would include all the circumstances, report on all the circumstances in relation to the death of General Alagic. I feel the need here to say a few words on behalf of the family of General Alagic, and in my own name. General Mehmed Alagic and so many other accused who come before this Tribunal and who demonstrate that this respect for this Tribunal, he respected the Tribunal. He expected that this Tribunal would come with a just verdict, and he hoped for it. He was absolutely convinced that the verdict would be just. His family has asked me to pass on their regrets that he's not able to come here and to defend himself and his name. Whatever the case, we hope that the Prosecutor will withdraw the name of General Alagic from the indictment and that today this will be confirmed at this Status Conference. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Thank you. The Trial Chamber records its condolences on the death of Mr. Mehmed Alagic and requests the Defence counsel to pass on the condolences to the family. The Trial Chamber would also like to record that all the reports on conditions for provisional release regarding Mr. -- the late Mehmed Alagic were positive. There were no problems at all. He complied with all the conditions that the Trial Chamber had set. And this in itself shows that he was well disposed towards the proceedings before this Tribunal. It's unfortunate that he has passed away before the proceedings even started or were completed. Our deep condolences to the family and also to the Defence counsel and his friends and all those who knew him. The Trial Chamber would advise that the death certificate should be formally filed so that it's formally on record, in order for the Prosecution to take the relevant steps they need to take. Yes, we'll proceed now with the rest of the programme for the Status Conference. The Trial Chamber has received the report of the Senior Legal Officer on the meeting which the parties had with the Senior Legal Officer.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: The Trial Chamber on pending motion, we're still awaiting the decision of the Appeals Chamber. But one motion regarding -- I think there's one motion pending which the Trial Chamber should be able to release, I think in two weeks' time, regarding the archives. Yes. I was informed that the problems with the Sarajevo archives have been sorted out between the parties. There is nothing outstanding. On the Tuzla archives, I have been informed that the Prosecution should be able to release the documents which they have in their possession within two weeks. Is that so?

utterances.speaker: MR. WITHOPF
utterances.text: That's correct, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: On the progress of the preparations, according to the meeting, dates have been agreed upon for the proposed amendments of the indictment by the Prosecution, and I'm informed that the date of 25th March as the deadline has been agreed to by the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. WITHOPF
utterances.text: That's also correct, Your Honour. The Prosecution will make a few amendments to the current amended indictment and that will happen prior to or on 25th of March.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes. And that the Defence will be able to respond any matters raised therein by the 25th of April. And then the next preparations, where we're trying to see whether this trial can start in the summer of this year, the parties have agreed on a schedule, indicating that the pre-trial brief by the OTP should be filed by 2nd June, and the pre-trial brief by the Defence, by the 1st of July, and that the date of 21st July is proposed for the Pre-Trial Conference, or a date during that week, and that it is hoped that the start of the trial will be directly after the summer recess. And the parties have agreed to this, I take it. Yes. So a Scheduling Order will be issued, according to the schedule agreed upon, unless there are other matters to be raised. Regarding the provisional release of Mr. Hadzihasanovic and Mr. Kubura, the Trial Chamber notes that the reports have been positive. There are no problems so far. And the two of them have also complied with all the conditions for provisional release. Are there any other matters the parties would like to raise? The Prosecution?

utterances.speaker: MR. WITHOPF
utterances.text: Your Honour, not from the side of the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Thank you. The Defence?

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] There are no other issues by the Defence. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: There being no other issues, the Status Conference is adjourned, and the Court will rise.
